body:
Recently my uncle was let out of jail for previous drug experiences. With no where to go, he showed up on my mothers door step asking her for some place to sleep. He got a job hanging awnings and working on trucks. Pay checks being saved, going to drug programs, trying to straighten out. Things were going very well for him until earlier this year. He's been using heroin since he was 19, he's 39 now. My Mom was still going to college when he started using. She knows when he's on the stuff. She says she can tell from the nodding and the glassy eye look. I've seen him while he was on the nod, its pretty scary.
She knew he was using the drug again because there were things taken, money missing and he would disappear for days after stealing something of value, (I.e. My laptop!) well, she kept letting him back, after all, he is my uncle and her brother. Well, one night after coming home from a meeting, he went into the basement where he clams he was doing some laundry. This was at 11:00 pm. My Mom is sleeping, and I'm getting ready for bed. As I lie down, I hear the t.v. Goes on downstairs. I think he's just gonna go to sleep.
I fall asleep around like 11:10 pm.. Around 1:30 am I wake up to a loud noise coming from the basement. I think nothing of it, I have a dog and 2 cats, probably just a fight going on or something, so I go back to sleep. Around 3:20 am, my Mom wakes me up saying there are weird noises coming from the basement. I get up and proceed downstairs, turning the corner to enter the laundry room, I see my UNconscious uncles feet from behind the wall.
I immediately told my Mom to call an ambulance. I checked for a pulse, he was bearly alive. The noises were him struggling for air because his throat was closing up. With a syringe still in his hand, I tried to pick him up, yelling his name, trying to smack him out of it. Nothing worked. I've never been so scared in my entire life. I leaned him up aganist the wall, splashed freezing cold water on his face while he made weird pathetic moaning noises.
When the paramedics arrived, they laid him back down and gave him about 2 or 3 shots of that stuff that blocks opiates. He opened his eyes and started swearing and moaning. He was shouting 'No!', 'Leave me alone!', 'Give me more!'. He was pissed because they woke him up. He threw up on one of the paramedics. They brought in the stretcher and carried him out.
The next day when my Mom picked him up from the hospital, he said he was sorry, hoping that would make everything all better. Well, as of this time my Mom had enough. She told him she was getting tired of being used to support his habit, and was only helping him by letting him stay at our house. So she kicked him out. Later that day he showed up at our house totally waked out! He couldn't walk, but yet drove his truck here. He got all his belongings and left. God only knows where he is now.
All I can say is, coming from a family that has a drug addiction history, I will never, ever, touch any other drug besides alcohol! People please think of this before you shoot up next time. Just imagine holding your uncle in your hands, praying for him to keep breathing and for his heart to keep beating. Imagine how I felt, do you really want to put someone through that?
